title: JewelMind JDL v1 Canonical Document
description: Structural (schema-layer) validation for a JDL v1 Canonical Document. This schema mirrors the CURRENT backend Pydantic model (backend/jewelmind/domain/schema.py) exactly: it enforces types, literal/enum membership, and additionalProperties=false. It deliberately does NOT enforce jewelry business-rule thresholds (minimum band width, prong count set membership, positive dimensions, etc.) that the current backend enforces only at the semantic-validation layer (backend/jewelmind/validation/engine.py) rather than at the Pydantic/schema layer. See docs/bible/05-jdl/075-validation-pipeline.md for why these two layers are kept separate, and docs/bible/05-jdl/065-canonical-json-serialization.md for the one known schema-layer blind spot (non-finite numeric tokens).

bandTaper.description: MINOR, additive Sprint 17 field (see docs/bible/19-shank/README.md and docs/bible/05-jdl/081-schema-versioning-and-migrations.md). mode="NONE" (the default) is bit-identical to pre-Sprint-17 geometry; bottomRatio is ignored when mode="NONE".

bottomRatio.description: Fraction of the base (head) dimension retained at the bottom of the ring when mode="TOWARD_BOTTOM".

schemaVersion.description: The only JDL schema version currently accepted. Default when omitted: "0.1.0".

size.description: EU/French ring size. Positivity and range (1 < size < 50) are semantic rule JM-RING-002, not enforced here.

innerDiameter.description: Millimeters. Range (10 < x < 30) is semantic rule JM-RING-001, not enforced here.

width.description: Millimeters. Minimum 1.5mm / maximum-warning 12mm are semantic rules JM-BAND-001/JM-BAND-003, not enforced here.

thickness.description: Millimeters. Minimum 1.4mm is semantic rule JM-BAND-002, not enforced here.

diameter.description: Millimeters. Range (2mm to 15mm) is semantic rule JM-STONE-001, not enforced here.

depth.description: Millimeters. Range is semantic rule JM-STONE-002, not enforced here.

prongCount.description: Deliberately NOT constrained to {4, 6} at this layer. The current backend intentionally keeps prong-count set membership as semantic rule JM-PRONG-001 so an out-of-set value produces a structured diagnostic rather than a raw schema-parse error (see backend/jewelmind/domain/schema.py comment on SettingSpec.prongCount).

prongDiameter.description: Millimeters. Minimum 0.8mm is semantic rule JM-PRONG-002, not enforced here.

prongHeight.description: Millimeters. Must exceed basketHeight per semantic rule JM-PRONG-004, not enforced here.

basketHeight.description: Millimeters. Positivity and 8mm warning ceiling are semantic rules JM-SETTING-001/JM-SETTING-002, not enforced here.

meshTolerance.description: Millimeters. Positivity IS enforced structurally here, matching Pydantic Field(gt=0) on PreviewSpec.meshTolerance.

angularTolerance.description: Radians (confirmed by inspecting the installed CadQuery source: Shape.mesh() passes this value directly into OCCT's BRepMesh_IncrementalMesh angular-deflection parameter, which OCCT documents in radians). Positivity IS enforced structurally here, matching Pydantic Field(gt=0).
